searches.query: new data science tools and frameworks
searches.answer: The sources highlight several new data science tools and frameworks for 2026. Streamlit is noted for its ease in creating interactive data science applications and dashboards using Python scripts. Apache Arrow is mentioned for revolutionizing data storage and transfer in big data applications through its in-memory columnar format. Apache Spark is recognized for its role in big data processing, supporting batch and streaming data analysis across multiple languages. Optimus is highlighted for its flexibility in using various data engines and formats. Cleanlab is praised for its agnostic design, working with any classifier regardless of the framework used. Pandas is described as an open-source tool for data manipulation and analysis built on Python’s Numpy. The sources also mention ConnectorX as a lesser-known but valuable tool.
